summary: The customer reported an incorrect interest credit in their account.

intents.keywords: नमस्ते मैं अमित शर्मा बोल रहा हूं...खाते में गलत ब्याज क्रेडिट हुआ है।
intents.actions of agent: The agent acknowledged the issue, asked for the account number, verified the issue, and raised a request to correct it.
intents.Process Request: Request to correct the interest calculation error.
intents.resolution: The interest will be updated in 3-5 working days, and the customer will be notified.
